page: Microsoft Azure E32-16ads_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Eadsv7 family. It features a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor with 16 vCPUs, 8 physical cores, and a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The server is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per core. It also includes 1890 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression single-threaded tests all scoring in the top 10%. Multi-core CPU performance and multi-threaded decompression fall into the average range. Memory performance is strong, with PassMark memory scores in the top 25%, while uncached memory read and write bandwidths remain average. In terms of workloads, the server demonstrates top-tier text generation speeds for small LLM models, though performance drops to weak for large 70B models.

Given its high memory density of 16 GB per core and bundled 1890 GB local storage, this server offers qualitative resource density efficiency for memory-intensive workloads without requiring extra storage provisioning. It is well-suited for memory-optimized databases, caching layers, data processing, and single-threaded execution tasks that benefit from its high clock speed and strong single-core performance.
